description: In-memory CPU graph ingestion, five chunks per document, 20 timed new documents after one warmup, 128 dimensions. Setup, provider work, HTTP, output serialization and WAL fsync excluded. Combined catalog COW, graph append path and profile cache changes.

rayon.configuration: Both environment variables were unset; the runner inherited the session environment without env overrides and the benchmark uses the default global Rayon pool.

same_environment_followup_probe.method: A lightweight standalone Rust probe linked to the same compiled Rayon dependency, run in the same sandbox with the same inherited environment after measurement; this was not an ingestion benchmark.

rayon.interpretation: Default 16-worker CPU configuration, verified by a follow-up probe; the original timed process did not record its worker count directly. Fanout 0 performs no semantic vector search. Fanout 2 can use parallel exact vector scans when engine size thresholds permit.

aggregation: Median of three per-process medians; p95 is median of three per-process p95s. Each process contains 20 timed appends.
source: Examples and source from the captured before snapshot /tmp/vectors-scale-baseline-source and shared workspace /Users/kb/Documents/Codex/vectors; canonical example identical in both trees.

reproduction.scope: Use the recorded source revisions, distinct recorded before/after executables, and the same 16-logical-CPU host. Run each of eight cases three times, alternate before/after order by round, and keep other build/benchmark work idle. An explicit 16-worker run is a reproducibility alternative, not the original invocation.

final_engine_patch.scope: Engine and storage changes against the saved pre-change working tree. Includes only a lint/format cleanup in engine.rs after timing; benchmark source hashes record the measured versions.
